response.description: A variant designation which is 1) a variant of the Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), 2) believed to have genetic mutations that increase binding affinity to human cells, 3) linked to rapid spread in human populations, and 4) is being monitored.
response.label: variant of concern (SARS-CoV-2)

response.description: A variant designation which is 1) a variant of the Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), 2) demonstrated to have genetic mutations that increase binding affinity to human cells, 3) linked to rapid spread in human populations, and 4) is under surveillance.
response.label: variant of interest (SARS-CoV-2)

response.description: A variant designation which is 1) a variant of the Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), 2) containing genetic mutates that may increase binding affinity to human cells, 3) linked to rapid spread in human populations, 4) is being monitored, and 5) denoted as a lower risk than a Variant of Interest (VOI).
response.label: variant under monitoring (SARS-CoV-2)
